title: Barnes v. Felix (2025)
key_points: Holding: Rejected the 'moment of threat' approach; courts must consider the totality of the circumstances, including events leading up to the use of force.
officer_notes: Scenario: An officer jumps on a slowly moving car's doorsill during a traffic stop and fires.
Takeaway: Your decisions leading up to force are part of the reasonableness review; de-escalate early.
